rules.statement: The measure's commitment and contract period is at least four years and ends on 31 December 2028.

conditions.description: The start year determines the stated six-, five-, or four-year duration.

result.description: Contract ends 2028-12-31.

rules.statement: The last entry is funding year 2025, requiring application by 31 December 2024.

conditions.description: A new entry after funding year 2025 is requested.

result.description: No new measure contract may be created.

rules.statement: In the first participation year, at least 0.50 ha in total of wine, fruit or hop land must be farmed.

conditions.expression: sum(eligible wine + fruit + hop area) < 0.50 ha
conditions.description: First-year eligible crop area is below the threshold.

result.description: Minimum participation area is not met.

rules.statement: Cut-vine vineyards count as wine area and are subject to the insecticide waiver; vine nurseries do not count as wine area.

conditions.expression: parcel is cut-vine vineyard or vine nursery
conditions.description: Classify the parcel type for measure area.

result.description: Include cut-vine vineyards, exclude vine nurseries.

rules.statement: Throughout the contract period, the holding must completely refrain from insecticides on all of its wine, fruit and hop areas.

conditions.expression: any measure crop parcel has a non-exempt insecticide application
conditions.description: The waiver is farm-wide across wine, fruit and hop land.

result.description: The content obligation is breached.

rules.statement: For admissibility, every plant-protection product registered by AGES with effect type 'Insektizid' is prohibited.

conditions.description: AGES register effect type controls classification.

result.description: Classify the application as prohibited unless a stated exception applies.

rules.statement: Insecticides permitted under Regulation (EU) 2018/848 may be used.

conditions.description: The product is permitted under the cited organic regulation.

result.description: The use is excepted from the waiver.

rules.statement: A competent authority's pest-control order permits the authority-approved active ingredient; it is not counted as insecticide use, but the order and use must be documented.

conditions.description: The use implements an official pest-control order with its authorised active ingredient.

result.description: Use is allowed only where both the order and application are documented.

rules.statement: Purchase and storage of non-exempt insecticides are prohibited; products permissibly used in other crops are excepted only when quantities are plausible for crops grown and records prove this.

conditions.description: Assess purchase/storage for each item.

result.description: Other-crop exception needs plausible quantities and records.

rules.statement: For a blanket plant-protection application through application year 2025, the relevant PSM code must be recorded in INVEKOS-GIS for affected parcels.

conditions.expression: year <= 2025 and blanket plant-protection application occurs
conditions.description: Historic reporting obligation for the affected parcel.

result.description: Record the applicable PSM code.

rules.statement: PSMBIO denotes organic-farming-permitted products, PSMCSI chemical-synthetic insecticides, and PSMCS other chemical-synthetic products; PSMCSI is always required for chemical-synthetic insecticide use.

conditions.expression: year <= 2025 and application class is known
conditions.description: Select code by product class.

result.description: Return PSMBIO, PSMCSI, or PSMCS as applicable.

rules.statement: Planned codes may be entered in advance; codes must be deleted once no use will occur, and changes or additions must be made immediately.

conditions.description: The previously recorded code no longer matches anticipated or actual use.

result.description: Amend the GIS code immediately.

rules.statement: Through 2025, chemical-synthetic insecticide use under an official pest order still requires PSMCSI and upload of the official order via Eingaben → andere Eingaben.

conditions.expression: year <= 2025 and officially ordered chemical-synthetic insecticide is applied
conditions.description: Exception use triggers reporting and upload.

result.description: PSMCSI plus order upload are required.

rules.statement: From application year 2026, PSM coding rules cease and plant-protection uses need not be recorded in the multiple application.

conditions.description: Current application year is 2026 or later.

result.description: No PSM code or multiple-application PSM record is required.

rules.statement: Whole-farm combination with Biologische Wirtschaftsweise is excluded; it is possible only with Biologische Wirtschaftsweise – Teilbetrieb with crop scope arable land and grassland.

conditions.description: Assess the type and scope of organic participation.

result.description: Only the stated partial-farm scope is admissible.

rules.statement: The optional Erosionsschutz Wein, Obst und Hopfen supplement for organisms or pheromones is reduced by 50% when the farm participates in o6_12.

conditions.expression: o6_12 participation and Erosionsschutz organism/pheromone supplement
conditions.description: Both measure participation and optional supplement apply.

result.description: Apply factor 0.5 to the optional supplement.

rules.statement: A switch to Biologische Wirtschaftsweise during measure duration was possible only by 31 December 2025.

conditions.description: A later switch is requested.

result.description: The stated switch option is unavailable.

rules.statement: Fruit premium requires high-quality planting material, normally grafted material, for both new and existing orchards; ungrafted walnut trees must be filed with OP and receive no ÖPUL premium.

conditions.description: The orchard material is not grafted/high-quality.

result.description: The parcel must be marked OP; ungrafted walnut is expressly named.

rules.statement: The annual rate is EUR 250/ha for wine, fruit and hop in 2023 and EUR 270/ha from 2024.

conditions.description: Use crop category and year to select rate.

result.description: Apply the per-hectare rate.

rules.statement: The land-use types Sonstige Weinflächen and Sonstige Spezialkulturflächen receive no premium in this measure.

conditions.description: Parcel is reported as an excluded other wine or other special-crop land-use type.

result.description: Set the measure premium to zero.

rules.statement: Funded areas must be in Austria; farmed areas outside Austria receive no funding and cannot count for limits such as crop shares.

conditions.description: The farmed parcel is outside Austria.

result.description: Exclude the foreign area.

rules.statement: All ÖPUL 2023 participating farms must meet conditionality requirements to receive the full funding amount.

conditions.description: Requirements cover climate/environment, public health, plant health, animal welfare and social conditionality.

result.description: Full funding is not available.

rules.statement: On permanent/special crops and wine areas, orderly planting, annual orderly care, and harvest/removal of the crop are minimum management criteria.

conditions.expression: special crop or wine parcel lacks planting, annual care, harvest or removal
conditions.description: Apply the crop-specific minimum management test.

result.description: Minimum management criteria are not fulfilled.

rules.statement: Nursery areas, other wine/special-crop areas, incorrectly declared or inactive land and specified national-park areas are not ÖPUL eligible; obligations can nevertheless remain on national-park land.

conditions.expression: parcel has a listed non-eligible characteristic
conditions.description: Apply the general non-eligibility list.

result.description: No premium for the affected area.

rules.statement: An OP-coded area receives no ÖPUL premium in that funding year; OP is required for listed causes including unfulfilled harvest, overlapping public funding, non-year-round compliance or ungrafted orchard material.

conditions.expression: parcel is affected by an OP cause
conditions.description: The annual compliance or premium condition cannot be met.

result.description: Report OP (or measure-specific OP code) and pay no premium.

rules.statement: Obligations generally run for the entire calendar year, and only units fulfilling obligations for the full commitment duration are eligible; a transferee may continue obligations to the end.

conditions.expression: obligations are not fulfilled from 1 January through 31 December
conditions.description: Assess every funded area for the full commitment period.

result.description: Use OP/measure-specific OP if transferee does not continue.

rules.statement: Although the measure contract lasts to 2028, the measure is bound to the areas available for it each year, which may differ annually.

conditions.description: Use that year's available measure areas.

result.description: Annual eligible areas can differ.

rules.statement: Measures and options must be applied for in the multiple-application measures application by 31 December before contract start to create a valid contract in the following year.

conditions.expression: application submitted after 31 December before intended start
conditions.description: The pre-contract deadline is missed.

result.description: No valid next-year contract is created.

rules.statement: An exit from a multi-year measure before the contract end generally triggers recovery of already granted measure premiums and may breach combination obligations.

conditions.expression: early exit and no specific approved exception
conditions.description: Measure ends before contractual end.

result.description: Recover already paid premiums.

rules.statement: For farms with wine areas, a 2026 early exit due to American grapevine leafhopper control can be granted without recovery; it ends from the start of the individual report, permits chemical-synthetic insecticides thereafter, and pays no 2026 measure premium.

conditions.expression: approved 2026 application for special circumstances citing control against American grapevine leafhopper
conditions.description: Submit online under Eingaben → Andere Eingaben using the higher-force/special-circumstances form.

result.description: Original contract ends early without recovery of earlier premiums.

rules.statement: In affected areas in Styria, Burgenland and Lower Austria, a specifically ordered chemical-synthetic active ingredient, or lack of available bio active substance, does not breach the obligation; staying in the measure has no premium loss, and order plus measures must be documented but not sent to AMA.

conditions.expression: 2026 official regional control order applies on a wine area
conditions.description: Assess ordered active ingredient and bio-substance availability.

result.description: No breach or premium loss; retain documentation for controls.

rules.statement: All measure premiums are reduced by whole-farm area modulation: 100% through 200 ha, 90% for the portion over 200 to 300 ha, 85% over 300 to 1,000 ha, and 75% over 1,000 ha.

conditions.description: Calculate the weighted farm-wide payment factor.

result.description: Multiply the premium by the weighted area factor.

rules.statement: From 2025 the general ceiling for the sum of area payments is EUR 1,300/ha, excluding intercropping, system evergreen and nonproductive arable/agroforestry payments as stated.

conditions.expression: sum of relevant area-based payments exceeds annual ceiling
conditions.description: Apply the funding-year ceiling.

result.description: Area-payment sum is limited to EUR 1,300/ha from 2025.

rules.statement: Content breaches are assessed by severity, extent, duration and frequency, with warning or 2/5/10/25/50/100% reduction; two 100% reductions in the contract period cause exclusion and recovery, and from 2027 a warning becomes 1% withholding.

conditions.description: Apply measure-based breach assessment.

result.description: Apply the stated reduction/exclusion scale.
